asyntai-intro: Text at the top of the settings page.
asyntai-sync: Heading of the knowledge base sync settings.
asyntai-field-widget-id: Label of the Widget ID field.
asyntai-field-widget-id-help: Help text under the Widget ID field.
asyntai-field-widget-id-invalid: Error shown when the Widget ID has the wrong shape.
asyntai-field-api-key: Label of the API key field.
asyntai-field-api-key-help: Help text under the API key field.
asyntai-field-api-key-stored: Shown next to the API key field when a key is stored.
asyntai-field-api-key-none: Shown next to the API key field when no key is stored.
asyntai-field-sync-enabled: Label of the checkbox that turns the sync on.
asyntai-field-sync-enabled-help: Help text under the sync checkbox.
asyntai-field-namespaces-help: Help text under the namespaces field.
asyntai-field-website-id: Label of the website ID field.
asyntai-field-website-id-help: Help text under the website ID field.
asyntai-saved: Message shown after the settings were saved.
asyntai-status-heading: Heading of the sync status box.
asyntai-status-tracked: Status line. $1 is the number of pages.
asyntai-status-queued: Status line. $1 is the number of queued jobs.
asyntai-status-last-sync: Status line. $1 is a date and time, or {{msg-mw|asyntai-status-never}}.
asyntai-status-never: Used in {{msg-mw|asyntai-status-last-sync}} when no page was sent yet.
asyntai-status-last-error: Status line. $1 is an error message.
asyntai-sync-all: Label of the button that queues every page.
asyntai-sync-all-help: Help text under the button that queues every page.
asyntai-sync-all-queued: Message shown after every page was queued. $1 is the number of pages.
asyntai-sync-needs-key: Error shown when the sync is requested without an API key.
asyntai-error-limit: Error stored when the Asyntai daily upload limit is reached.
asyntai-error-auth: Error stored when the API key is refused. $1 is the HTTP status code.
asyntai-error-http: Error stored on another HTTP error. $1 is the status code, $2 the response text.
asyntai-error-network: Error stored when the request fails. $1 is the error text.
